summary: A story of the steps it took to reach us to the place our ancestors dreamt of . To touch the sky and come back . To realize "a god" is nothing but hot mass of gases or a satellite rotating around the earth . To see them upclose . Ofcourse they leave behind a story . A story to be told.
details: The glorious pieces of metals left on the Moon the Mars and the surroundings of Earth , computed by molten sand and the hands of the architects . What is it now , if not a piece of metal? What value do they bear ? Let us find out the phylophical meaning and reasons for creating the foundation for a vast mesmerizing view of this universe.
